Definition
[Levi-Civita covariant derivative] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0293 ↗ appa-def-vector-action-on-function 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

The Levi-Civita connection of $g$ is identified with the covariant derivative, the unique operator \[ abla : C^\infty (T\mathcal M^n) o C^\infty (T\mathcal M^n\otimes T^*\mathcal M^n) \] such that \[ X igl(g(Y,Z) igr)=g( abla _XY,Z)+g(Y, abla _XZ) \] for all vector fields $X,Y,Z$.
